messages:
alice-m: Quick cross-service check — we're planning the handback for router shard s42 at 23:15 UTC. Staging shows a +120ms p95 delta in runtime after the header-shim landed. Can we hold the pin and run a short KV backfill before unpin? @liam-r @ana-p :hourglass:
liam-r: I saw that spike too. Header-shim code is fine, kernel picked q8 path; the spike is mostly cold-starts. Backfill should help for sure.
ana-p: typo — i'm ana-p :sweat_smile: How long is the backfill estimated to take in staging?
ana-p: i can kick it off, should be ~12–18m with 6 parallel workers.
deploybot: deploy scheduled: wave=canary services=[api,runtime,console,router] start=2026-03-24T23:00Z. Use `/deploy status` for live updates.
alice-m: ok — plan: hold router pin, run backfill (15m), then smoke p95 test. If runtime p95 < 80ms, unpin and proceed. If not, roll back router header-shim and pin API to previous variant.
liam-r: concurs. Backfill command to run: `scripts/backfill_kv --shard s42 --parallel 6 --batch-size 5000` — that should populate prefixes that trigger cold paths.
sre-bot: monitor created: staging-runtime-p95 threshold=85ms; notify=#eng-oncall if >85ms for 2m.
ana-p: starting backfill in staging now. posting logs: `backfill|shard=s42|started|workers=6`
deploybot: canary started: api(40%), runtime(40%), console(40%). Console shows header-shim enabled on 7/10 nodes.
alice-m: good. If backfill restores latency, we unpin router at +40m and escalate to full. If not, rollback plan: pin router and api to previous variants, abort full rollout.
liam-r: tagging release notes: "Header shim rollout — temporary router pin during handback; KV backfill to mitigate cold-start latency." Add rollback steps.
ana-p: backfill finished. sample log: `backfill|shard=s42|finished|duration=11m34s|items=1.2M`
liam-r: verified staging runtime: p95=74ms, p50=22ms. Good to unpin.
alice-m: executing unpin: `/deploy unpin router --wave canary` — will observe 5m and then move to full if stable.
deploybot: command accepted: unpinning router (canary). Progress: 0/1 -> in-flight.
alice-m: watching logs and traces. thank you all — notify here if any unusual errors :thumbsup:
